posts.text: I do believe that our hummingbirds have bailed out on us in the last two or three days. The males left first, and now I’m pretty sure the ladies are gone as well.
The turtlehead flowers (Chelone) are good enough to offer the bees a pull-through pickup lane for pollen.
A bumblebee working into a bottle gentian flower. They’re pretty much the only pollinator that can do it!
